fields.notes: Block guide does not specify confidentiality / integrity / authentication requirements for the serial peripheral. Any access-control (e.g. privileged-mode register access) is deferred to SoC integration.
requirements: RPMB (Replay Protected Memory Block): authenticated reads/writes with HMAC-SHA256, a one-time-programmable 256-bit key, and a monotonic write counter to defeat replay attacks.
Secure Erase / Secure TRIM guarantee actual erasure of targeted data.
Sanitize physically purges all unmapped/trimmed data.
Secure Write Protect (eMMC 5.1) protects regions from modification.
Field Firmware Update (FFU) installs a vendor-signed firmware image.

extraction_hints: Look for key-management, side-channel, secure-boot sections.
